name: primitives-headless-checkbox
title: Headless Checkbox
description: A launch checklist card with four task rows; clicking a square toggles it, filling the box and drawing the tick in with a short animation.
use: A checklist or settings list needs custom square checkboxes with a drawn tick.
avoid: It ships unstyled on purpose, so you must supply the box borders, colours and focus ring.
a11y: The tick is drawn with motion and no reduced-motion check is made; focus styling and the accessible name are left to you. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card with the heading Launch checklist, a grey subtitle and four rows. Each row has a small rounded square checkbox and a white task label; checked boxes are solid white with a dark tick.
behaves: Clicking a square toggles it: the box fills white and the tick draws itself in over a fifth of a second, and unchecking reverses it. The whole label row is clickable, and the box grows slightly on hover.
customise: Wrap your own box and indicator as children, set defaultChecked or a controlled checked value, and style the square with classes; the tick path and timings are fixed.
weight: light: Four tiny buttons with SVG ticks; nothing runs at rest.
